description: Content cluster audit regressions (CNT-01): one audit-*.test.ts(x) test per audited or critic-predicted defect in server components, live, rich text and the editor, blog, disks and media, cache, mail, notifications and webhooks. Each entry is a test that asserts the correct behaviour and fails today; the closing CNT package removes its entry.

test: live/capture-row-contents: a captured change carries the row key, not its columns

failure.message: password hash was copied into the change record
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Capture re-reads every written row and stores all scalar columns (password and token hashes included) in the change log; the feed only ever needs the key.

test: live/capture-reread: capturing a committed write issues no extra read

failure.message: capture re-read the written row
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Every committed write costs one extra SELECT to re-read the row, even for entities no publication covers.

test: live/capture-bulk-update: an update by criteria marks the collection changed

failure.message: a bulk update reached no subscriber
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: A query-builder update carries no primary key and runs outside a capture frame, so capture drops it and live clients keep stale rows.

test: live/capture-bulk-delete: a delete by criteria marks the collection changed

failure.message: a bulk delete reached no subscriber
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: A delete by criteria has no keyed entity event, so capture drops it and live clients keep deleted rows.

test: notifications/notifiable-index: the notifications table indexes the notifiable column every read filters on

failure.message: no index leads with notifiable
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: jsails_notifications has no index on notifiable, so list, unreadCount and markAllRead scan the whole table.

test: notifications/timeout-cancels-attempt: a channel attempt that times out is told to stop through an AbortSignal

failure.message: the channel received no AbortSignal
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The dispatcher races a timer without an AbortSignal, so a timed-out send keeps running and may still deliver.

test: notifications/concurrency-bound: a timed-out attempt still counts against the channel concurrency until it ends

failure.message: concurrency 1 let \d+ attempts run at once
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: A timed-out attempt frees its worker while it keeps running, so the concurrency bound does not bound in-flight sends.

test: notifications/failure-cause: a failed delivery keeps the channel error as its cause

failure.message: the channel error was discarded
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Failures are reduced to channel names by a bare catch; the cause is lost.

test: mail/address-shape: an address needs a local part and a domain

failure.message: "@" was accepted as an email address
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: assertMailAddress only requires one '@', so '@', 'ada@' and '@example.com' pass.

test: mail/body-required: a message with neither text nor html is refused

failure.message: a message with no body was accepted
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: validateMessage accepts a message with neither text nor html.

test: mail/memory-transport-bounded: the in-memory transport keeps a bounded capture

failure.message: the capture grows without bound
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: InMemoryMailTransport keeps every captured message forever.

test: webhook/form-encoded-body: a verified form-encoded delivery (Slack commands) reaches the handler

failure.message: a correctly signed form-encoded delivery was refused
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: handleDelivery always JSON-parses the body, so verified form-encoded Slack deliveries get 400.

test: webhook/acknowledge-before-processing: a delivery is acknowledged once stored, without waiting for its handler

failure.message: did not settle within
failure.name: SettleTimeoutError

entries.reason: The handler runs inside the sender's request; a slow or dead process loses the event and holds the replay claim (at-most-once).

test: filesystem/variant-follows-source: a variant is derived again when its source bytes change

failure.message: the variant of the overwritten source is still served
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Variant keys hash (source key, name, params), not source content, so an overwritten source keeps its old variant.

test: filesystem/variant-known-per-process: a variant purged by one instance is not reported as present by another

failure.message: instance B returned a key that no longer exists
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The resolver's known-key set is per process, so another instance keeps returning purged keys until restart.

test: media/orphan-on-index-failure: an upload whose index write fails leaves no bytes on the disk

failure.message: the bytes stay on the disk with no index row
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: upload writes the bytes, then the index row, with no rollback or two-phase commit.

test: media/custom-type-keeps-foreign-extension: a stored filename never keeps an extension that implies another type

failure.message: stored as notes\.html
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: reconcileExtension keeps the original filename when the recorded type has no known extension, so an allowed custom type keeps an .html name.

test: content/duplicate-slug: two pages that claim one slug fail discovery instead of one replacing the other

failure.message: one of the two pages silently vanished
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: buildCollection sets bySlug in order, so a later page with the same frontmatter slug replaces an earlier one without an error.

test: content/render-cache-collision: the render cache never serves one file the HTML of another

failure.message: BB\.md was served Aa\.md's cached HTML
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Render-cache files are named by a 31-bit string hash of the path, so colliding paths share an entry.

test: content/feed-xml-illegal-characters: a feed never contains XML-illegal characters

failure.message: one control character invalidates the whole feed
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Feeds escape HTML but pass XML-illegal control characters through.

test: blog/default-memory-repository: the blog plugin refuses to start without a persistent repository

failure.message: keeps every post in process memory
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: blogPlugin defaults to an in-memory repository, which loses every post on restart.

test: blog/write-path-search-sync: publishing, unpublishing and deleting a post keep the search engine in step

failure.message: a published post never reached the index
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Only the admin save and revision restore call the search engine; publishPost, unpublishPost and deletePost never do.

test: blog/optimistic-locking: a save based on a stale read of a post is refused

failure.message: posts carry no lockVersion
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: updatePost is read-modify-write with no version check, so concurrent editors overwrite each other.

test: blog/term-delete-dangling: deleting a category removes it from the posts that carried it

failure.message: the post still names the deleted category
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: deleteCategory and deleteTag leave the id in posts' JSON term arrays.

test: blog/term-archive-reads-all-posts: a category archive page reads that page of posts, not every published post

failure.message: one archive page hydrated \d+ post rows
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: publishedTermPage loads every published post and filters term membership in JavaScript.

test: blog/database-search-scans: a database search reads the matching page, not every post with its body

failure.message: one search hydrated \d+ post rows
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The database search driver calls listPosts and matches in JavaScript on every public search.

test: blog/orama-per-process: a post published through one instance is searchable on another

failure.message: instance B still searches its startup snapshot
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The default Orama index is built per process on first search and only updated by in-process calls.

test: blog/search-page-unbounded: the search route bounds the page it asks the engine for

failure.message: the engine was asked for results up to #\d+
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: GET /blog/search passes an unbounded page to the engine (OpenSearch answers 400, surfaced as 503).

test: blog/sitemap-requeries: the sitemap is read once per content version: fresh after a write, cached otherwise

failure.message: two sitemap requests with no write in between read posts \d+ times
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The sitemap re-reads up to 50 000 posts on every request with no version-keyed cache.

test: live/resnapshot-single-flight: oversized changes re-snapshot a subscription one at a time

failure.message: \d+ snapshot queries ran at once for one subscription
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: resnapshot has no in-flight guard, so k oversized changes run k concurrent snapshot queries per subscription.
